analysis.session_summary: The dollar was weakest major, -0.299% with DXY losing 0.334%, while AUD led +0.338% and closed at its best. NZ employment miss (-0.1% vs 0.4%) initially knocked NZD -0.457% but it recovered 82%. Risk appetite improved as VIX fell 12.054%; ISM Services miss (54.5 vs 54.8) produced inverted USD strength, showing positioning rather than data.

themes.evidence: DXY -0.334%, USD strength -0.299%, VIX -12.054%; AUD strongest +0.338%.
Employment Change actual -0.1% vs forecast 0.4%; NZD own impulse -0.457%, later recovered 82% from -0.62% trough.
ISM Services 54.5 vs 54.8 forecast; USD strengthened +0.047% despite miss, marked inverted.

currency_drivers.USD: DXY fell 0.334%; ISM miss triggered inverted USD strength, signaling positioning rather than data.
currency_drivers.EUR: Core CPI Flash 2.5% matched forecast with muted -0.032% basket reaction; strength attempt faded.
currency_drivers.JPY: Led +0.364% then gave back 78%; no own releases or clear catalyst.
currency_drivers.GBP: Held its range at +0.086% with no UK releases; no own catalyst.
currency_drivers.AUD: Strongest major at +0.338%, closed at its best; no own releases.
currency_drivers.CAD: Held its range at -0.091% with no Canadian releases; no own catalyst.
currency_drivers.CHF: Early +0.598% attempt rejected, gave back 76%; no own releases.
currency_drivers.NZD: Employment miss forced -0.457% initial drop; recovered 82% to close -0.081%.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: EUR/USD netted +40.7 pips across five legs: two USD-negative up legs (+75.5, +46.2) outweighed three down legs, including a midterm-driven -36.6 pip drop.

polarity_reads.read: NZD weakened 0.457% on a normal miss; the quick 82% recovery indicates dip-buying rather than trend.
USD strengthened 0.047% on a miss; inverted reaction implies short positioning or hawkish services interpretation.

polarity_reads.read: Muted -0.032% basket move on in-line 2.5% leaves EUR without an inflation impulse.

scenarios.name: USD rebound on positioning squeeze
scenarios.thesis: ISM inverted reaction shows USD shorts are vulnerable; a hawkish BOE or strong US claims could force a sharp USD recovery.
triggers: BOE Official Bank Rate above 4.00% or hawkish votes
scenarios.invalidation: DXY fails to hold above 101.306 close.

pair_paths.rationale: Unwinds today's +40.7 pip gain if dollar strength resumes.

scenarios.name: Risk-on continuation
scenarios.thesis: VIX -12.054% and AUD closed at its best point to ongoing dollar weakness; no US catalyst expected to reverse the tape.
triggers: US Unemployment Claims in line with 197K forecast
scenarios.invalidation: VIX closes above 17.564 or DXY reclaims 101.306.

pair_paths.rationale: AUD closed at its best; today's +44.5 pip gain extends.
NZD recovered 82% from its low; today's +12.3 pip gain builds.
USD softness persists; today's -36.9 pip drop extends.
EUR/USD today's +40.7 pip gain extends on dollar weakness.

scenarios.name: Pre-BOE choppy range
scenarios.thesis: Market waits on BOE, SNB and BOC speakers; pairs stay inside today's ranges with no fresh USD catalyst.
triggers: Mixed central bank commentary and claims
scenarios.invalidation: Any pair breaks today's range (e.g., EUR/USD above 88.4 pips).
